band.basis: Channel and grate from QV Drainage/Channel Drains and Gratings table t16 at 100mm nominal width across all three load tiers (310-561/m AKL), plus a computed haunch allowance (40-60/m), plus a connection cost amortised over an assumed 15m run with 5m of 100mm outlet pipe and one break-in at <=1.5m depth (~50-110/m), plus ~0.5 m2/m of paving reinstatement (~60/m at the high end only). Low end = residential duty, minimal reinstatement, shallow short connection. High end = heavy transport duty, full haunch, reinstatement and a longer connection. Sub-bands: residential 400-500/m, light commercial 500-650/m, heavy transport 650-850/m. All GST exclusive, NZD
